description.name: Telegram Notifications
description.tagline: Secure, real-time Telegram alerts for WHMCS: sales, support, security and provisioning events.
description.long: Telegram Notifications sends real-time alerts to a Telegram chat, group or channel for sales, support, security and provisioning events in WHMCS. Security alerts (admin logins, failed login attempts, account changes and fraud orders) can be routed to a separate chat. Hardened for WHMCS 9 and PHP 8.2+: client input is escaped, sensitive content is opt-in and Telegram outages never block checkout or payment callbacks.
features: Sales: new orders, paid invoices, refunds and cancellation requests.
Support: new tickets (including guests) and client replies with optional preview.
Security: admin logins with trusted IP/CIDR allow-list and failed admin login summaries.
Security: client and user email or password changes, with who made the change.
Security: orders flagged by the fraud check.
Operations: failed service provisioning and domain registration, renewal or transfer.
Optional separate Security Chat ID for security alerts.
HTML-escaped messages, opt-in sensitive content, no link previews, masked bot token.
Non-blocking delivery with strict timeouts and error isolation.
Built-in log viewer with delivery status and custom admin folder support.
